description: 1. INITIALIZE: Call `python3 scripts/command.py list-datasets-info` to discover the pre-existing `trial_sites` dataset and confirm `trial_participants` does not yet exist. 2. CREATE DATASET: Call `python3 scripts/command.py create-dataset trial_participants participant_id name score visit site` to register the schema. 3. BATCH INGEST with type consistency: Parse `data/raw/trial_participants_batch2.csv` and call `batch-append-to-dataset trial_participants '<json>'` passing ALL values as strings (since CSV values are strings, the first record locks all fields as `large_string` — mixing int for `score` in any row would cause a Lance type-mismatch error). 4. READ BACK: Call `read-dataset trial_participants` to retrieve all records and parse the JSON response to find P0017 (Irene Novak)'s auto-generated `_id` UUID. 5. UPDATE: Call `update-dataset-record trial_participants <_id> P0017 'Irene Novak' '88' Visit1 SiteC` with the extracted UUID and all fields keeping string types. 6. WRITE AUDIT: Create `ingestion_audit.json` with keys for dataset_name (`trial_participants`), total_records (10), and a record or note about the correction to P0017's site from SiteX to SiteC.
